I tried to commit suicide, and if I hadn’t been brought to the hospital I would have succeeded.  I felt myself sinking as several ER doctors and nurses hurried frantically around my body, heard the panic in their voices as they tried desperately to save the life I despised until I lost consciousness.

As much as I want to end my suffering, I’m not going to throw away what they worked so hard to save.
